decisions.reason: As a homepage-featured extension of the firm's traditional handcrafted seasonal décor, it fits core capabilities well and is inexpensive to keep as an option while demand becomes clearer.
This is very close to the firm's established Christmas pyramid business, so early uncertainty is limited and the product is likely to stay in the range.

Although the electronic music box is more distant from the firm's craft-based core and therefore riskier, its prominent launch suggests management would keep the option open a bit longer before abandoning it.
This accessory is both distant from the core offer and only weakly featured, so if the underlying electronic concept does not quickly prove itself it is a likely candidate for withdrawal.
As a seasonal accessory tied to the uncertain electronic music-box line, it has narrower upside and is more likely to be dropped to free resources for stronger core products.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's established strengths and market identity, making it a low-risk product to retain.
